description: Stock routes - Queensland is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. This dataset displays selected road and land parcels which represent the certified Stock Route Network (SRN) of Queensland. The SRN, defined by the Stock Route Management Act 2002, provides pastoralists with a means of moving stock 'on the hoof' around the state as an alternative to trucking. Coverage: Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources and Mines, Manufacturing and Regional and Rural Development. It offers 4 resource(s) in REST, SHP, TAB, FGDB, KMZ, GPKG, WMS, XML. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
